description: Observatoire du déploiement des compteurs intelligents pour l'électricité en Région de Bruxelles-Capitale is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Brugel. This observatory aims to inform consumers about the deployment of smart meters in the Brussels-Capital Region (RBC). It provides an overview of the evolution of deployment, the share of smart meters across the low voltage electricity meter fleet, as well as their distribution by metering regime (R0, R1, R3) and customer type. Coverage: Brugel. The portal shows the English title as "Observatory on the deployment of smart meters for electricity in the Brussels-Capital Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Brugel. Its keywords include Énergie, counter, Energy, compteur, environment, Energie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
